arguments.name: x

origin.details: Widths are trimmed when trim_ws is true.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- read_fwf(readr_example("fwf-sample.txt"), fwf_widths(c(20, 10, 12), c("name", "state", "ssn")))
paste(parsed$name[1], parsed$state[1], parsed$ssn[1], sep = "|")

translation.description: Widths are trimmed when trim_ws is true.

translation.details: Widths are trimmed when trim_ws is true.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
parsed = read_fwf(readr_example("fwf-sample.txt"), fwf_widths([20, 10, 12], ["name", "state", "ssn"]), show_col_types=False)
return str(parsed.columns[0][0]) + "|" + str(parsed.columns[1][0]) + "|" + str(parsed.columns[2][0])
